remarks: Great opportunity for an owner-occupant or investor! This spacious two-unit property offers tons of potential and sits on an impressive triple lot with a huge three-car garage — a rare find. Each unit features three bedrooms and one full bath, along with its own walk-out porch. The lower unit also offers an enclosed porch for additional usable space.The property has several important updates already in place, including newer windows throughout, a roof approximately 9 years old, and a furnace approximately 10 years old. A full attic offers even more potential and could provide substantial additional space if finished.The interior is ready for cosmetic updating, giving the next owner an opportunity to add their own style and value. With generous room sizes, abundant outdoor space, off-street parking, an oversized garage, and expansion potential, this property has plenty to offer. Bring your ideas and make it your own! Property is being sold in as-is condition.
